batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b B Lee

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: st PA Patel b RA Jadeja

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c M Muralitharan b RR Powar

batting.name: B Lee
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b M Muralitharan

balls.text: the short ball and it's a slower one as well, Gomez tries to pull but is beaten by the change of pace, Powar runs a bye to the keeper
full toss on off and middle, Powar mis-hits it over the bowler's head, poor finish from Kochi
full toss on leg stump, Gomez missed out there, failing to make proper contact
slower ball dragged ungainly towards midwicket and Powar was gone had the fielder hit at the bowler's end. Ugly cricket all round.
full toss outside off stump, Powar has a heave but misses, he needs to give Gomez the strike
full ball outside off stump, Powar gets beaten
played towards long off for a single
played gently towards square leg, the keeper prevents the single, Ramesh Powar wanted the quick single
Vinay Kumar tries to slog across the line, aiming for the midwicket boundary. He misses a straight ball and is bowled
nudged off the back foot towards midwicket
shot! Gomez gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball hard and flat over the deep square leg boundary, hit with a lot of power
played from the crease towards long-on
full toss, with some inswing, played towards midwicket
driven off the front foot towards long-off
the yorker, swinging into middle and leg, worked through square leg
full ball on middle and leg, flicked in the air towards square leg
the batsman makes room and chips a short ball over the fielder at cover
short of a length ball fended off the back foot towards third man
played off the back foot towards midwicket
that's clumsy on the boundary, flicked off the pads towards deep midwicket where the fielder runnign to his left slid and tried to stop the ball with his legs, what are hands for? Shukla it was
a swish and a miss off the front foot outside off
loud shout for lbw as the batsman gets hit on the pad after missing the sweep
played back to the bowler
beaten on the back foot outside off stump
driven back to the bowler and Lee picks up on his follow through
played towards long-on for a single

caught on the long-on boundary! Jadeja gets lots of height on a heave down the ground but not enough distance, he cleared his front foot again and smashed it. Yusuf settled under the ball and took a well-judged catch a few yards in. He seems to be in some pain though after taking the catch
in the blockhole from Lee, dug out back to the bowler
that's too wide outside off stump
short ball and Jadeja has slammed it flat towards the square leg boundary, pulled from the crease for a one-bounce four
full ball on middle and off, Jadeja makes room and drives the ball towards cover, Gomez wanted a non-existent single

bowled him! Jadhav moved back into his crease to play across the line towards midwicket, Shakib slips in the arm ball that skids though and beats the bat to clip leg stump. That kept a bit low as well.
Jadeja pulls off the back foot this time but manages only a single to long-on, the ball reached the fielder on the bounce
nudged off the front foot towards midwicket, the bowler gives chase
played towards midwicket
right, Jadeja's on to something here. Makes room again by moving his front foot towards leg and carts the ball over long-on
that's too short and Jadhav pulls along the ground to the fielder on the deep midwicket boundary
played towards point
massive shot! Jadeja moves his from foot out of the way and slams the ball with terrific force over the deep midwicket boundary. Yusuf would have been proud of that shot
leading edge but it falls safely in the direction backward point
the ball angles into the left-hander from round the wicket, Jadeja pushes off the back foot towards midwicket where Gambhir fails to stop it
played off the back foot towards square leg, the fielder has to charge in from the boundary
nudged off the pads through midwicket
length ball from Balaji, Jadeja clears his front foot out of the way to create hitting space and swings his bat hard, sending the ball cleanly over long-on off the front foot
nudged off the front foot towards mid-on once again
nudged gently into the wide open space at midwicket, the fielder has to run in from the boundary
Jadhav steps out of his crease, latches on to a length ball and lofts it flat towards his team-mate at the bowler's end. Jadeja ducks successfully and the ball beats mid-on as well
good length angling into the right-hander, Jadhav defends towards cover
good length ball outside off, defended towards point
worked off the pads behind square for a single
lbw! Yusuf slants the slightly quicker one into the left-hander from round the wicket, Parthiv pushes forward but defends down the wrong line, misses the ball entirely and he's struck plumb in front
Jadeja tries to sweep but it doesn't come off, he gets hit on the pad and they run a leg bye towards the off side
the ball doesn't come on to the bat and Prathiv goes back to pull towards long on
no noise at Eden Gardens as Parthiv sweeps and sweeps well, into the gap on the square leg boundary
nudged towards backward point for a single
short of a length ball around off, Parthiv stands tall on the back foot, relatively speaking, and dabs the ball into the ground towards slip
another big drive, Jadeja tries. This time he gets an inside edge that just misses the stumps, trying to hit it too hard
Kolkata have lost three wickets for nothing, so Jadeja leaps down the track and has an almighty heave at a length ball that angles across him, makes contact with air
fuller ball outside off stump, Jadeja stays in his crease and tries to play the booming drive through cover, doesn't make contact
Parthiv tries to hit a length ball on the off but gets an inside edge on the leg side
closer to off stump this time, marginally so. Parthiv lets it go
length ball slanting across the left-hander, too wide outside off
and that is a wicket maiden, Jadeja defends watchfully off the front foot

middle stump lies flat on its back and that is an exuberant celebration from Yusuf! Hodge went on the back foot to pull one from outside off, the pitch is slow so the ball didn't come on to the bat, he ended up inside-edging it on to middle
played off the front foot towards the off, Yusuf moves to his left to field
played towards midwicket
played off the pads on the leg side, the wicketkeeper runs and fields
Hodge barely moves his feet to a wicket-to-wicket delivery and defends
Hodge waits and nudges towards square leg for a single
nudged off the front foot behind square
a touch short and Parthiv pulls off the back foot but can't beat midwicket
swept behind square for a single
played off the front foot towards point
played towards square leg for a single

lbw! Mahela isn't happy but he has to go, he got down on one knee and tried to sweep, he missed and got hit by a straight ball. The doubt was whether the impact was outside the line of off stump. The ball hit the under side of the thigh guard and looked in line. There was glove on the ball, though, that's why Mahela was unhappy. Aleem Dar gets one wrong
Jayawardene nudges towards mid-on but midwicket cuts it off
Jayawardene gets down on one knee and then waits before sweeping, this time he can't beat short fine leg
worked off the back foot towards square leg
a touch short outside off stump, cut off the back foot with power but straight to point
nudged off the pads through square
that's an odd-looking shot, McCullum began to play the cut along the ground behind point but then lifted his bat to chip the ball tamely in the air towards backward point, a top-edge of sorts
Jayawardene waits in his crease and plays towards midwicket
McCullum charges and drives with power towards long-off
turned of the pads behind square
huge appeal for lbw as Jayawardene moves forward and closes the face to play towards leg, that struck him plumb in front but only after hitting the inside edge
McCullum moves back and works the ball off his pads through midwicket
played towards mid-on
played in front of square for a single

but this is what he's doing, he keeps moving away towards leg and the bowler follows him, and then he moves towards the off, gets inside the leg and creates the space to sweep over short fine leg for four
Jayawardene backs away towards leg and cuts the ball from right in front of his stumps towards backward point, risky shot, if Mahela misses, Abdulla hits
defended on the front foot towards the bowler
played off the back foot towards midwicket
cut once again off the back foot but can't find the gap at cover point
Jayawardene gets inside the line by moving towards the off and sweeps the ball in the air over the man at short fine leg, one-bounce four
Jayawardene makes room by moving towards leg, Shakib follows him, cut towards cover point but he can't pierce the infield
cut from the crease towards backward point
Jayawardene moves towards the off, gets down on one knee, and sweeps from outside off to short fine leg
McCullum comes down again and plays on the leg side
McCullum works the ball off his pads towards midwicket
loud shout for lbw after Jayawardene misses the sweep and gets hit on the pad, Aleem Dar says not out, did that turn enough to miss off?
sublime, Jayawardene makes room by moving towards leg and threads the short ball through point with a precise and deft cut
McCullum jumps out of his crease and drives to long-off
McCullum closes the face to play on the leg side but gets a leading edge that falls short of cover
played back to the left-arm spinner
McCullum tries to go through the off side this time but mis-times the drive towards mid-on
McCullum charges once again and Lee bowls him a short ball, the batsman reaches out for it and swats it from around off stump towards cow corner
driven off the front foot to mid-on, that was a yorker
shot! McCullum charges forward and then transfers weight on to the back foot before pulling a short ball flat over the deep midwicket boundary
McCullum charges down the pitch and drives a length ball powerfully through extra cover, such a contrast in styles, McCullum and Mahela.
short ball and very straight, McCullum tries to pull and then half-ducks, he ends up in an awkward position and gets beaten
length ball outside off stump, Jayawardene stays in his crease and opens the face to play towards point
Balaji appeals for lbw as one nips back into the right-hander and hits the pad after Jaywardene misses the flick, that was missing leg
defended from the crease towards point
Jayawardene takes a step towards leg to make room and loft a length ball over cover, graceful shot but clinically executed
pushed off the front foot towards cover, McCullum sets off from the non-striker's end but gets sent back
Jayawardene charges and tries to hit over the off side, doesn't make contact
he delivers from wide of the crease and pitches equally wide off the crease, the ball swerves away from the keeper, who has to dive a long way to his right
good length ball on middle and leg, Mahela tries to work the ball off his pads but misses, they scamper a leg bye towards short midwicket
pushed from the crease towards point
short ball on leg stump, can't do that to Mahela when fine leg is in the circle, Mahela swivels so quickly and pulls past the fielder to the long-leg boundary
McCullum sits on the back foot this time and slaps the short of a length ball between extra cover and mid-off, Morgan moves to his left and dives
McCullum charges Lee but gets cramped for room by a short of a length delivery which angles into him, plays it on the off side awkwardly
good length ball pitches outside off and seams away from the right-hander, McCullum lets it go and the keeper fumbles
Vinay bowls off a short run to ensure he doesn't over-step and the batsman hits it towards mid-off, Kochi have defended superbly

Bhatia slugs the ball down the ground, the fielder at long-on runs to his left and slides to field, Bhatia returns for the second but doesn't dive as Parthiv breaks the stumps, it's very close and he's on the line as the bails come off, a dive would have saved him
and it is! Another slower ball outside off and Abdulla can't do anything with them, mis-times the hit towards the off side

another super slow ball, worked of the pads through midwicket, no pace to hit the ball with and Abdulla plays through midwicket, he dives full length to complete the single and manages to do so in the nick of time before Parthiv breaks them
another slow ball and Abdulla mis-times the hit through cover, they come back for the second at the throw to Parthiv is poor
a clever slow ball outside off stump, it was extremely slow and Adbulla was hopelessly beaten
another low full toss but Abdulla tried to hit it too hard, mis-timed towards cover
Abdulla makes room and drives the ball through cover, the attempted yorker finished up as a low full toss
Bhatia steps out and lofts towards long-on, better length this time, much fuller
Abdulla makes a bit of room to hit one that angles into him through point
fuller ball, played to extra cover
RP has bowled a rubbish full toss, the yorker gone wrong, and Bhatia pulls wide of the fielder at long-on
pulled off the back foot from off stump through the leg side
Abdulla makes room and slaps the ball in the air through cover point
the batsman misses the sweep and gets hit high on the thigh
caught at long-on! Lee stood in his crease and smashed the ball hard and flat, he didn't get enough elevation though and Jadhav barely had to move as the ball sped to him at head height
Bhatia cuts off the back foot towards point, singles won't do for Kolkata
Lee forces the ball off the back foot through extra cover
Murali strays down leg side, Bhatia misses the sweep, the ball beats the keeper as well and short fine leg has to field
played back to the bowler, terrific over from Jadeja, the game is headed Kochi's way

stumped! Superb thinking from Jadeja if that was intentional. Tiwary steps out of his crease, Jadeja sees him coming and fires the ball flat and fast down leg side. Tiwary misses it and Parthiv completes the stumping
another one in the blockhole, played back to the bowler
bowled in the blockhole around off, dug out on the off side
Bhatia tries to work the ball off his pads but can't make contact
flicked in the air towards deep midwicket
defended back to Jadeja
down on one knee and swept from wide outside off towards deep square

caught at short third man! Huge moment in the game. Powar went round the wicket to change the angle, slanting the ball across the right-hander with flight, Yusuf aimed for the midwicket boundary this time but his heave resulted in a top edge to Murali
this is what this man does, uses his reach and power to clobber the spinners, Powar disappears over deep midwicket
shocking ball, a short and wide long hop outside off, Yusuf hammers it off the back foot through cover but Gomez sprints to his right and dives full length to save the four
Tiwary steps out and nudges the ball towards midwicket
Tiwary slog sweeps in the air towards deep midwicket
bowled him! RP Singh sent down a very low full toss, Shakib moved towards the off to swing the ball through leg, he missed and the ball hit leg stump before going towards fine leg
that's a much better length, in the blockhole outside off, Shakib makes room to hit through point and is beaten
played down the ground for a single, full length again
full ball outside off played towards point, Shakib sets off for the single before getting sent back, he comes in between the stumps and the throw
another length ball, and Tiwary smashes it, stepping out and pulling in front of square this time, terrible length from RP
superb shot! Tiwary steps forward and towards the off to a length ball, getting inside the line a touch before pulling through square leg
Shakib pushes the ball on the off side
this time he makes contact with the pull and hits it to deep midwicket
defended towards short cover
pulled again off the back foot and he misses it this time, getting hit on the thigh, Parthiv catches and appeals in hope
terrific effort from Hodge but it's fallen just short. Tiwary pulled off the back foot but mis-hit it towards midwicket. Hodge dived forward but couldn't reach it
a touch short from Murali and Shakib cuts off the back foot
Shakib punches off the back foot through cover point
played from the crease with an open face towards third man
defended back to the bowler
played towards point

massive wicket as Morgan is run out. Played towards extra cover and Morgan was backing up too far at the non-striker's end and took few steps forward for the single before turning back. Jayawardene swooped on the ball and scored a direct hit at the bowler's end, beating Morgan's dive. Aleem Dar didn't even refer it
short of a length ball outside off, Tiwary tries to guide towards third man and was beaten. The bowler and keeper appeal for the catch but there was no edge
Tiwary makes room to cut and hits it from in front of his stumps
steps out to flick but the ball hits the pad
played towards midwicket
Tiwary gets under the ball and lofts it so high, so high, it didn't look like he hit it far enough but when the ball landed, it was over the long-on boundary
Morgan plays the reverse-hit through cover, places it in the gap and along the ground
Tiwary steps out of his crease and lofts the ball in the air towards deep square leg where it falls short of the fielder
nudged through square leg once again, the right-hander this time
full and straight, Morgan moves across and works the ball through square leg
the batsman goes right back and plays through midwicket
driven off the front foot towards cover
played off the front foot on the off side
nudged off the pads gently though wide mid-on and the call is for two, the fielder doesn't gather cleanly and Morgan takes advantage

edged! Morgan had little idea of the delivery that angled into him and then bounced and spun away, he hung his bat out and the edge went fine of the fielder at short third man. Odd, it's been given byes. I thought I saw an edge
flicked in the air but through the gap between square leg and midwicket
Tiwary tries to cut but Murali bowled the straighter one and beat the bat
a touch short on off stump, cut off the back foot through point
played from deep in the crease on the leg side
pitches outside leg stump, loose ball, but paddle swept to the fielder at fine leg
cut dangerously from in front of his stumps towards point
bowled with lots of flight and drift on off stump, Morgan stays in his crease and plays towards point
Tiwary jumps out of his crease and nudges towards square leg
bowled flatter and straighter, Tiwary moves forward and defends towards midwicket
tossed up outside off stump, Morgan leans into the cover drive
played towards midwicket for a single
Morgan gets down low and scoops the ball from leg and middle towards the fine-leg boundary. Innovative shot well executed
Tiwary makes room to drive the ball from middle and leg through cover point
a bit too short and Morgan cuts off the back foot through cover point
the ball grips and rips off the pitch with a lot of bounce, Morgan tries to cut but is beaten
played towards point off the back foot
defended from deep in the crease on the leg side
driven off the front foot towards extra cover
chipped in the air over the infield at cover
Morgan aims to drive a flighted ball that spun through cover but gets an edge past first slip
Morgan pre-mediated the paddle sweep and had to play it from far outside off, he hit it with the toe of the bat and the ball lobbed safely on the off side
Tiwary moves back and dabs the ball late past the keeper
the batsman gets down on one knee to paddle sweep but misses and was hit on the pad, impact was outside off
bowled him! Bisla makes a bit of room and tries to drive on the off side, he played inside the line and the ball held its line to hit off stump
Bisla steps out and flicks the ball off his pads through square
worked towards midwicket for a single
Tiwary tries to turn the ball towards leg but Jadeja pitches off and spins it away to beat the bat
Eden Gardens roars to life as Tiwary launches the ball off the front foot over the wide long-on boundary
pushed off the front foot towards cover
short of a length ball and Tiwary moves forward and across and nudges towards the leg side
defended on the leg side
played towards mid off off the front foot
defended from the crease towards the off side

bowled him! Gambhir's middle stump has been uprooted. RP Singh bowled a good length ball that pitched on middle and straightened, Gambhir closed the face too early and was beaten, Kochi are definitely in this now. Gambhir played from his crease when he should have been forward
defended towards cover

Gambhir backs away towards leg and hits the ball towards cover and then runs for a crazy single. He would have been out by yards if there was a direct hit at the bowler's end. He'd have been run out by inches had Vinay Kumar decided to go to the stumps and collect the ball
played off the back foot towards point by opening the face
Gambhir works the ball off his hips behind square

caught on the deep square leg boundary! It was a bouncer and Kallis pulled it even though there was a fielder in the deep. The fielder nearly over-ran the ball moving to his left but took the catch in the end. Kallis had fallen to the short ball against Rajasthan as well. He made good contact this time, just picked out the fielder
short of a length ball outside off stump, Kallis smashes it off the back foot but can't beat point
length ball on leg stump, Kallis nudges off his pads towards long leg
played from the crease towards midwicket
Bisla charges and lofts the ball with the angle into him over midwicket
full ball on off stump, driven towards long-on for a single
worked off the pads through square leg
Kallis stays in his crease and punches past extra cover, where McCullum dives but fails to intercept
Jadeja bowls his left-arm dart from round the wicket, played through midwicket
length ball on off and middle, worked off the pads through midwicket
Bisla makes room to a length delivery and cuts from in front of his stumps towards point
Bisla makes room by moving towards leg and tries to hit through cover, he gets a thick outside edge that flies wide of the keeper for four
short ball and Kallis pulls towards the man on the deep square boundary
Kallis tries to force through the off side but gets an inside edge on to the pad, that kept low and didn't come on to the bat
short of a length outside off stump, cut off the back foot towards third man
the slower bouncer and Kallis misses the pull
short ball pulled towards deep square leg
left-arm filth, pitches outside leg stump and Bisla still misses the leg glance, the ball hits his thigh pad and runs to the fine-leg boundary
punched off the front foot towards point
pitches outside leg stump on a length and Kallis flicks towards deep square leg
left-arm short of a length ball from over the wicket, played from the crease towards square
